gpt-image-1.5.notes: Microsoft retires Azure OpenAI gpt-image-1.5 (version 2025-12-16) on 2026-12-16 and names no replacement yet.

gpt-image-1.notes: Microsoft retires Azure OpenAI gpt-image-1 (version 2025-04-15, preview) on 2026-10-23 and names no replacement.

gpt-4o-transcribe.notes: Azure retires gpt-4o-transcribe 2025-03-20, its only version, on 2026-10-15 and names no replacement; gpt-4o-mini-transcribe 2025-12-15 stays available until 2027-06-15.

whisper.notes: Microsoft retires Azure OpenAI whisper (version 001) on 2026-12-15 and names no replacement yet. Azure bills it per audio hour, which the catalog cannot express, so it is unpriced.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: Azure promotional Global Standard pricing ($4 input / $20 output per 1M), announced to run from 2026-09-01 through at least 2026-11-30. The standard rate is $5 / $30 with $0.50 cached input and $6.25 cache writes; restore it when the promotion ends.

gpt-5.3-chat.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-5.3-chat (version 2026-03-03) on 2026-06-29; replacement gpt-chat-latest.

gpt-5.2-chat.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-5.2-chat (version 2025-12-11 on 2026-05-13, version 2026-02-10 on 2026-06-29); replacement gpt-chat-latest.

gpt-5.1-chat.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-5.1-chat (version 2025-11-13) on 2026-06-29; replacement gpt-chat-latest.

gpt-5-chat.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-5-chat (version 2025-10-03 on 2026-05-13, version 2025-08-07 on 2026-06-29); replacement gpt-chat-latest.

gpt-4.1.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4.1 (version 2025-04-14) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2027-04-14 with no replacement listed yet.

gpt-4.1-mini.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini (version 2025-04-14) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2027-04-14 with no replacement listed yet.

gpt-4.1-nano.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4.1-nano (version 2025-04-14) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2027-04-14 with no replacement listed yet.

codex-mini.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI codex-mini (version 2025-05-16) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-11-15 with no replacement listed.

o3-pro.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI o3-pro (version 2025-06-10) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-11-19 (replacement: gpt-5.6-sol).

o4-mini.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI o4-mini (version 2025-04-16) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-11-19 (replacement: gpt-5.6-terra).

o3.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI o3 (version 2025-04-16) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-11-19 (replacement: gpt-5.6-sol).

o3-mini.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI o3-mini (version 2025-01-31) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-11-19 (replacement: gpt-5.6-terra).

o1.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI o1 (version 2024-12-17) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-11-19 (replacement: gpt-5.6-sol).

gpt-4o.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4o as deprecated (version 2024-05-13 retires on 2026-12-09, replacement gpt-5.6-sol; version 2024-08-06 retires on 2027-04-14, replacement gpt-5.1; version 2024-11-20 is legacy and retires on 2027-04-14).

gpt-4o-mini.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4o-mini (version 2024-07-18) as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2027-04-14 with no replacement listed yet.

gpt-4.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-4 (versions 0314 and 0613) on 2025-06-06; replacement gpt-4o (version 2024-11-20).

gpt-4o-2024-08-06.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4o version 2024-08-06 as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2027-04-14 (replacement: gpt-5.1).

gpt-4o-2024-05-13.notes: Microsoft lists Azure OpenAI gpt-4o version 2024-05-13 as deprecated (closed to new customers); it retires on 2026-12-09 (replacement: gpt-5.6-sol).

gpt-3.5-turbo-0613.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-35-turbo (version 0613) on 2025-02-13; replacement gpt-4o-mini.

gpt-3.5-turbo-16k.notes: Microsoft retired Azure OpenAI gpt-35-turbo-16k (version 0613) on 2025-04-30; replacement gpt-4.1-mini (version 2025-04-14).
